title: Copilot Chat Controls and License Data Quality
description: GitHub added new Copilot Chat controls on github.com including minimize-and-resume support for conversations and quicker access to recent chats. Also includes license data quality improvements for supply chain management.

title: Cross-Session Messaging
description: Claude Code sessions can now message each other on macOS and Linux, enabling sessions to share findings and decisions directly instead of requiring users to re-explain context across sessions. Released in version 2.1.224.

title: v0.54.0 Stable Release - Security and Core Updates
description: Gemini CLI released v0.54.0 stable with enhanced authentication & security features, model fallback & history filtering. Added new commands including /agents refresh and /skills reload for managing agent and skill configurations.

title: Google Workspace Plugins
description: Cursor introduced plugins giving coding agents direct access to Gmail, Google Drive, and Calendar. Users can now read, write, and act across their Google Workspace without leaving Cursor.
